obligation: Compiled .oxb bundle is embedded by generated wrapper source without stale external file assumptions
required_gate: generated source contains deterministic include_bytes bundle reference and scaffold validates expected project name and path

obligation: Wrapper initializes OxVba host runtime and executes prepared bundle through supported Engine APIs
required_gate: executable scaffold validates generated EXE source and runtime invocation surface

obligation: JIT v1 is purged and the `oxvba-jit` API reports not implemented until the JIT v2 design lands
required_gate: scaffold runs the not-implemented API guard
product_boundary: No JIT execution or fallback claim

obligation: Generated DLL exports use declared calling convention and C ABI argument carriers
required_gate: scaffold validates DLL shim source for exported symbol shape and invoke_procedure bridge
product_boundary: No unmanaged ABI parity beyond declared primitive carriers

obligation: Generated COM server source exposes entry points and class factory skeletons while dispatch invocation gaps remain explicit
required_gate: scaffold validates COM server source structure and evidence records dispatch and registration residuals
product_boundary: No full Office COM server parity claim

obligation: Generated XLL source exposes xlAutoOpen xlAutoClose and xlAutoFree12 skeletons plus registration metadata comments
required_gate: scaffold validates required XLL entry points and type-string generation
product_boundary: No complete Excel add-in packaging claim

obligation: External boundaries materialize declared ABI carriers while internal runtime values remain retained Variant semantics
required_gate: obligation evidence references representation decision and JIT slot ABI retained-carrier tests
product_boundary: No replacement of semantic value model with raw ABI slots

obligation: Windows is the primary COM/XLL packaging target and non-Windows wrapper claims are limited to surfaces that build without Windows-specific entry points
COM registration and deployment steps must be validated separately from source generation
required_gate: final checklist records whether registration helpers were exercised or remains residual
product_boundary: Source generation alone is not deployment evidence

obligation: Native scaffold artifacts identify command run id source docs and generated evidence paths
required_gate: scaffold emits markdown and CSV artifacts or no-artifacts temp outputs with run id
product_boundary: No product claim from unpublished local temp artifacts alone
